title: Friarsland Road, Goatstown, Clonskeagh, Dublin 14
description:
Video in link 

UNFURNISHED



Bespoke Estate Agents are delighted to present this exceptional five-bedroom detached bungalow to the rental market.
Nestled in a peaceful cul-de-sac setting, this bright and spacious home offers an abundance of natural light throughout and is presented in excellent condition.
The accommodation comprises five generously proportioned double bedrooms, including two en-suite bedrooms and an impressive principal suite featuring a walk-in dressing room. A modern family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.
The heart of the home is a large open-plan kitchen and dining area, which opens directly onto a fantastic outdoor entertaining space. A separate utility room provides additional convenience. To the front of the property, there is a spacious living and dining room, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.
Externally, the property boasts a mature, private and beautifully maintained south-facing garden that is not overlooked, offering an idyllic outdoor retreat. There is also ample off-street parking to the front of the property.
Available to let from 1st August, this outstanding home offers the perfect combination of space, privacy and convenience in a highly desirable residential location.
Key Features:
Detached bungalow in a quiet cul-de-sac
Five double bedrooms
Two en-suite bedrooms
Principal bedroom with walk-in dressing room
Spacious living/dining room
Large kitchen/dining area
Separate utility room
Family bathroom
Private, mature landscaped garden
Outdoor entertaining area
Ample off-street parking
Available from 1st September
This is a rare opportunity to rent a substantial family home in a tranquil and sought-after setting.

This is an energy efficient house which has  been beautifully maintained throughout and features include

PV Panels - no electricity bills in summer
Thermal panels - very small gas bills in summer
Garden not overlooked - surrounded by mature trees

This properties  location is well served by a variety of public transport options. The luas Green line is a short walk form the property. There are 13 schools & UCD close by, as well as Dundrum and Stillorgan Shopping centres within 5kms.
